name: Kanban Embed
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps headings and cards inside longer or mixed code fences out of board embeds.
Keeps a lane title such as C# whole.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Lines inside code blocks of a board file no longer show up as lanes or cards.
A lane title such as C# is no longer cut short.
tip: Add hide-done: true to a kanban-embed block to hide checked cards and show how many are hidden.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Kanban Embed is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
